--- app/src/test/java/com/ntt/crosstest/data/MissionReportMultiAttachmentTest.kt	
+++ app/src/test/java/com/ntt/crosstest/data/MissionReportMultiAttachmentTest.kt	
@@ -0,0 +1,224 @@
+package com.ntt.crosstest.data
+
+import android.app.Application
+import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
+import com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels.MissionReportViewModel
+import com.ntt.crosstest.util.PreparedScreenshot
+import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
+import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
+import org.junit.After
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.runner.RunWith
+import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
+import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
+import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
+import java.io.File
+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
+class MissionReportMultiAttachmentTest {
+
+    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+
+    @Before
+    fun setUp() {
+        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
+    }
+
+    @After
+    fun tearDown() {
+        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun testMultiAttachmentStoreSerializationAndCheckpoints() {
+        val reqId = "test-multi-req-1"
+        val att1File = PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context, reqId, "att1").apply { writeText("img1") }
+        val att2File = PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context, reqId, "att2").apply { writeText("img2") }
+        val att3File = PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context, reqId, "att3").apply { writeText("img3") }
+
+        val attachments = listOf(
+            PendingAttachment(
+                id = "att1",
+                position = 0,
+                screenshotPath = att1File.absolutePath,
+                imageHash = "hash1",
+                sha256 = "sha1"
+            ),
+            PendingAttachment(
+                id = "att2",
+                position = 1,
+                screenshotPath = att2File.absolutePath,
+                imageHash = "hash2",
+                sha256 = "sha2"
+            ),
+            PendingAttachment(
+                id = "att3",
+                position = 2,
+                screenshotPath = att3File.absolutePath,
+                imageHash = "hash3",
+                sha256 = "sha3"
+            )
+        )
+
+        val report = PendingReport(
+            id = reqId,
+            campaignId = "camp-123",
+            appName = "Test App",
+            userId = "user-456",
+            rating = 5,
+            comment = "Multi-attachment test report",
+            submissionContext = "mission",
+            missionId = "mission-789",
+            missionTitle = "3-day quest",
+            attachments = attachments
+        )
+
+        PendingReportStore.write(context, report)
+
+        val readBack = PendingReportStore.read(context, reqId)
+        assertNotNull(readBack)
+        assertEquals(3, readBack!!.attachments.size)
+        assertEquals("att1", readBack.attachments[0].id)
+        assertEquals("att2", readBack.attachments[1].id)
+        assertEquals("att3", readBack.attachments[2].id)
+        assertNull(readBack.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
+
+        // Test checkpoint on first attachment
+        PendingReportStore.markAttachmentUploaded(
+            context = context,
+            id = reqId,
+            attachmentId = "att1",
+            url = "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att1.jpg",
+            hash = "hash1",
+            thumbnailUrl = "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att1_thumb.jpg"
+        )
+
+        val checkpoint1 = PendingReportStore.read(context, reqId)!!
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att1.jpg", checkpoint1.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att1_thumb.jpg", checkpoint1.attachments[0].uploadedThumbnailUrl)
+        // Primary compatibility url also updated
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att1.jpg", checkpoint1.uploadedUrl)
+        assertNull(checkpoint1.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
+
+        // Test checkpoint on second attachment
+        PendingReportStore.markAttachmentUploaded(
+            context = context,
+            id = reqId,
+            attachmentId = "att2",
+            url = "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att2.jpg",
+            hash = "hash2"
+        )
+        val checkpoint2 = PendingReportStore.read(context, reqId)!!
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/att2.jpg", checkpoint2.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
+        assertNull(checkpoint2.attachments[2].uploadedUrl)
+
+        // Mark completed and verify all attachment local files are deleted
+        val result = SubmitTesterReportResult(
+            success = true,
+            reportId = "server-report-uuid",
+            status = "pending",
+            submissionContext = "mission",
+            missionId = "mission-789",
+        )
+        PendingReportStore.markCompleted(context, reqId, result)
+        assertFalse(att1File.exists())
+        assertFalse(att2File.exists())
+        assertFalse(att3File.exists())
+
+        // Receipt survives in store
+        val completed = PendingReportStore.read(context, reqId)
+        assertNotNull(completed)
+        assertEquals("server-report-uuid", completed!!.completedResult?.reportId)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun testPendingCampaignIdsFiltersByContext() {
+        val appTestReport = PendingReport(
+            id = "req-app-test",
+            campaignId = "camp-1",
+            appName = "App 1",
+            userId = "user-1",
+            rating = 5,
+            comment = "test",
+            submissionContext = "app_test"
+        )
+        val missionReport = PendingReport(
+            id = "req-mission",
+            campaignId = "camp-2",
+            appName = "App 2",
+            userId = "user-1",
+            rating = 5,
+            comment = "mission",
+            submissionContext = "mission",
+            missionId = "m-1"
+        )
+
+        PendingReportStore.write(context, appTestReport)
+        PendingReportStore.write(context, missionReport)
+
+        // Total pending campaigns
+        val allPending = PendingReportStore.pendingCampaignIds(context)
+        assertEquals(setOf("camp-1", "camp-2"), allPending)
+
+        // Filtered for app_test: mission report does not block app_test suggestions
+        val appTestPending = PendingReportStore.pendingCampaignIds(context, "app_test")
+        assertEquals(setOf("camp-1"), appTestPending)
+
+        val missionPending = PendingReportStore.pendingCampaignIds(context, "mission")
+        assertEquals(setOf("camp-2"), missionPending)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun testSubmitStateKeyDistinguishesContextAndMission() {
+        val keyOrdinary = ReportSubmitManager.submitStateKey("user1", "camp1", "app_test", null, "2026-11-02")
+        val keyMission = ReportSubmitManager.submitStateKey("user1", "camp1", "mission", "mission1", "2026-11-02")
+        val keyMissionDay2 = ReportSubmitManager.submitStateKey("user1", "camp1", "mission", "mission1", "2026-11-03")
+
+        assertTrue(keyOrdinary != keyMission)
+        assertTrue(keyMission != keyMissionDay2)
+        assertEquals("user1:camp1:app_test::2026-11-02", keyOrdinary)
+        assertEquals("user1:camp1:mission:mission1:2026-11-02", keyMission)
+        assertEquals("user1:camp1:mission:mission1:2026-11-03", keyMissionDay2)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun testTesterReportAllAttachmentsFallbackForSingleImage() {
+        val legacyReport = TesterReport(
+            id = "rep-legacy",
+            campaignId = "camp-1",
+            userId = "user-1",
+            screenshotUrl = "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/legacy.jpg",
+            thumbnailUrl = "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/thumb_legacy.jpg",
+            imageHash = "hash123",
+            submissionContext = "app_test",
+        )
+        val atts = legacyReport.allAttachments
+        assertEquals(1, atts.size)
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/legacy.jpg", atts[0].screenshotUrl)
+        assertEquals("https://storage.googleapis.com/test/thumb_legacy.jpg", atts[0].thumbnailUrl)
+
+        val multiReport = TesterReport(
+            id = "rep-multi",
+            campaignId = "camp-1",
+            userId = "user-1",
+            submissionContext = "mission",
+            attachments = listOf(
+                ReportAttachment(id = "1", position = 0, screenshotUrl = "url1"),
+                ReportAttachment(id = "2", position = 1, screenshotUrl = "url2"),
+                ReportAttachment(id = "3", position = 2, screenshotUrl = "url3"),
+            )
+        )
+        assertEquals(3, multiReport.allAttachments.size)
+        assertEquals("url1", multiReport.allAttachments[0].screenshotUrl)
+        assertEquals("url2", multiReport.allAttachments[1].screenshotUrl)
+        assertEquals("url3", multiReport.allAttachments[2].screenshotUrl)
+    }
+}

+# Backend Fixes State: Migration 074 App Mission Window & Multi-Attachments
+

+**Date**: 2026-11-02  
+**Status**: All 9 proven defects resolved. All 4 coordinator probes + test suites passing 100%.

+## 1. Scope & Isolation Compliance
+
+- **Exclusive Write Scope**: `supabase/migrations/074_app_mission_window_and_multi_attachments.sql`

+  - No Android files touched

+  - No `root-*.mjs` probe files modified or weakened
+  - No Gradle commands run
+  - No live credentials or production DB accessed
+
+---
+
+## 2. Issues Investigated & Corrected
+
+### Defect 1: `report_date` DEFAULT backfill corrupted historical rows
+- **Root Cause**: `ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);` backfilled every historical row with today's date in Postgres, making the subsequent `WHERE report_date IS NULL` a no-op and causing unique index violation 23505 on multiple historical days.
+- **Fix**: Added column without default, backfilled from `(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date WHERE report_date IS NULL`, then set default and `NOT NULL`.
+
+### Defect 2: `_submit_tester_report_core` lacked private ACL
+- **Root Cause**: `_submit_tester_report_core` had default execution grant to `PUBLIC`/`authenticated` under Supabase default grants.
+- **Fix**: Added `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(...) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ... TO service_role;`.
+
+### Defect 3: `tester_report_attachments` inherited write grants
+- **Root Cause**: `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;` omitted `authenticated`, leaving inherited DML write grants active.
+- **Fix**: Executed `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, authenticated, PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT ... TO authenticated; GRANT ALL ... TO service_role;`. Added check constraint `CHECK (image_hash IS NULL OR lower(image_hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')`.
+
+### Defect 4: Missing v3 client request ID accepted
+- **Root Cause**: `p_client_submit_id` defaulted to NULL and was not required in v2/v3 endpoints.
+- **Fix**: Enforced `if p_client_submit_id is null then raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_REQUIRED'; end if;` in `submit_tester_report_v2`, `submit_tester_report_v3`, and `_submit_tester_report_core` (when `p_attachments is not null`), preserving legacy `submit_tester_report` compatibility.
+
+### Defect 5 & 6: Secondary attachment URLs, hashes, and thumbnail pairs unvalidated
+- **Root Cause**: Validation only occurred via row triggers on primary screenshot fields in `tester_reports`. Secondary attachments in `p_attachments` were inserted into `tester_report_attachments` without checks.
+- **Fix**: Enforced per-item validation across all attachments in `_submit_tester_report_core`:
+  - `is_valid_report_screenshot_url(att->>'screenshot_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id)`
+  - `lower(att->>'image_hash') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'`
+  - `is_valid_report_thumbnail_url(att->>'thumbnail_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id, att->>'screenshot_url')`
+
+### Defect 7: Empty attachment array `[]` accepted
+- **Root Cause**: `if v_att_count > 0` bypassed checks for `v_att_count = 0`, retaining existing attachments silently.
+- **Fix**: Enforced `if v_att_count < 1 then raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_EMPTY...'; end if;` and `if v_att_count > 3 then raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS'; end if;`.
+
+### Defect 8: Legacy v2 cover update incoherent on multi-image report
+- **Root Cause**: When updating an existing report with `v_new_screenshot` via v2, `tester_reports.screenshot_url` was updated but `tester_report_attachments` was ignored when `p_attachments` was NULL.
+- **Fix**: Added synchronization of position 0 in `tester_report_attachments` with new cover URL/hash and cleared `sha256 = null`, while fully preserving positions 1 and 2.
+
+### Defect 9: Fingerprint delimiter collision
+- **Root Cause**: `v_att_canonical` used `:` delimiter concatenation, allowing `full + ':' + thumb` vs `thumb + ':' + thumb` to produce identical fingerprints.
+- **Fix**: Generated `v_att_canonical` via `jsonb_agg` ordered by position, guaranteeing distinct and tamper-proof fingerprints.
+
+### Defect 10: Admin queue overload ambiguity
+- **Verification**: Verified `admin_get_tester_reports_queue` retains its published 8-parameter signature with full backward compatibility and attachment inclusion.

+package com.ntt.crosstest.audit

+
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
+class MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest {
+    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+    @Before fun before() {
+        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
+        PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(context)
+        WorkManagerTestInitHelper.initializeTestWorkManager(context,
+            Configuration.Builder().setExecutor(SynchronousExecutor()).build())
+    }
+    @After fun after() {
+        WorkManager.getInstance(context).cancelAllWork().result.get()
+        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
+        PreparedScreenshotCache.clear(context)
+    }
+    private fun request(bytes: Long = 16, createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): PendingReport {
+        val requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        val images = (0..2).map { position ->
+            val imageId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+            val file = PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context, requestId, imageId)
+            RandomAccessFile(file, "rw").use { it.setLength(bytes) }
+            PendingAttachment(id = imageId, position = position, screenshotPath = file.absolutePath,
+                imageHash = "0123456789abcdef")
+        }
+        return PendingReport(id=requestId,campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),appName="Mission",userId="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",rating=5,comment="evidence",
+            screenshotPath=images.first().screenshotPath,imageHash=images.first().imageHash,
+            missionId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),submissionContext="mission",createdAt=createdAt,attachments=images,
+            expectedDate=java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")).toString())
+    }
+    private fun queue(report: PendingReport) {
+        val work = OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<ReportUploadWorker>()
+            .setInputData(workDataOf(ReportUploadWorker.EXTRA_REQUEST_ID to report.id))
+            .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiresCharging(true).build())
+            .addTag(ReportSubmitManager.TAG).build()
+        val manager=WorkManager.getInstance(context)
+        manager.enqueueUniqueWork("report_submit_${report.id}",ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP,work).result.get()
+        assertFalse("fixture work must remain unresolved",manager.getWorkInfoById(work.id).get()!!.state.isFinished)
+    }
+    @Test fun uploadedCheckpointRestoresOnlyTheMatchingAttachment() {
+        val report=request();PendingReportStore.write(context,report)
+        val second=report.attachments[1]
+        PendingReportStore.markAttachmentUploaded(context,report.id,second.id,"uploaded-second",second.imageHash,"thumb-second")
+        val restored=PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!
+        assertEquals(report.attachments.map { it.id },restored.attachments.map { it.id })
+        assertNull(restored.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
+        assertEquals("uploaded-second",restored.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
+        assertEquals("thumb-second",restored.attachments[1].uploadedThumbnailUrl)
+        assertNull(restored.attachments[2].uploadedUrl)
+        assertNull("legacy primary checkpoint must not be populated by image two",restored.uploadedUrl)
+    }
+    @Test fun completedReceiptRetainsAllImagesAndLeasedPreviewFiles() {
+        var report=request()
+        val prepared=report.attachments.map { image ->
+            val file=PreparedScreenshotCache.newFile(context,image.id).apply { writeText("preview") }
+            PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
+            image.copy(preparedPath=file.absolutePath)
+        }
+        report=report.copy(attachments=prepared)
+        PendingReportStore.write(context,report)
+        val receipt=SubmitTesterReportResult(success=true,reportId="server-report",submissionContext="mission",
+            attachments=prepared.map { ReportAttachment(id=it.id,position=it.position,screenshotUrl="url-${it.position}",imageHash=it.imageHash) })
+        PendingReportStore.markCompleted(context,report.id,receipt)
+        assertEquals(receipt,PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!.completedResult)
+        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
+        prepared.forEach {
+            assertFalse(File(it.screenshotPath).exists())
+            assertTrue("leased preview must survive receipt cleanup",File(it.preparedPath!!).exists())
+        }
+    }
+    @Test fun preparedCleanupRetainsAFileStillLeasedByTheDraft() {
+        val file=PreparedScreenshotCache.newFile(context,UUID.randomUUID().toString()).apply { writeText("draft") }
+        file.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
+        PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
+        PreparedScreenshotCache.cleanup(context)
+        assertTrue("age cleanup must not delete an image still referenced by an active draft",file.isFile)
+    }
+    @Test fun ageCleanupDoesNotEraseQueuedThreeImageWork() {
+        val report=request(createdAt=System.currentTimeMillis()-49L*60*60*1000)
+        PendingReportStore.write(context,report);queue(report)
+        PendingReportStore.cleanup(context)
+        assertNotNull("pending request still belongs to unresolved WorkManager work",PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id))
+        report.attachments.forEach { assertTrue("queued image must remain readable",File(it.screenshotPath).isFile) }
+    }
+    @Test fun budgetDoesNotCountTheSamePrimaryPathTwiceOrEvictQueuedWork() {
+        val reports=(1..3).map { request(bytes=1_900_000) }
+        reports.forEach { PendingReportStore.write(context,it);queue(it) }
+        val actualUniqueBytes=reports.flatMap { it.attachments }.map { it.screenshotPath }.distinct().sumOf { File(it).length() }
+        assertTrue("fixture should fit the existing20MiB image budget",actualUniqueBytes<20L*1024*1024)
+        PendingReportStore.cleanup(context)
+        reports.forEach { report ->
+            assertNotNull("cleanup must preserve each accepted unresolved request",PendingReportStore.read(context,report.id))
+            report.attachments.forEach { assertTrue(File(it.screenshotPath).isFile) }
+        }
+    }
+}

2: 
3: These are required corrections before handover. All reproductions use the real deployable migration chain in local PGlite and never use live credentials. Do not edit coordinator root-*.mjs tests or weaken their assertions. Fix product/migration behavior and rerun them; use the exact Gemini/medium model already requested.
4: 
5: ## Initial positive results
6: 
7: `root-daily-state-matrix.mjs` passed all six same-day combinations (both type orders × first report pending/approved/rejected), plus the next-day mission report after actual owner approval. Keep these working. `root-three-image-probe.mjs` passed three-image create/order, exact immutable receipt replay, 4-image rejection and changed-order/request-ID rejection.
8: 
9: ## Required fixes
10: 
11: 1. **Historical report dates are corrupted and upgrades fail with more than one historic day.** `ADD COLUMN report_date ... DEFAULT today` backfills every existing row with today; following `UPDATE ... WHERE report_date IS NULL` changes nothing. Independent upgrade with one yesterday report records today instead of yesterday; two historic days for same tester/campaign fail 23505 creating the new unique index. Add the column without default, backfill actual created_at/Vietnam date, validate historical identities, then set default/not-null/index. Ensure partial/rerun safety. Evidence `root-migration-upgrade-initial.log`; test `root-migration-upgrade-probe.mjs`.
12: 
13: 2. **New SECURITY DEFINER core is executable directly by clients.** `_submit_tester_report_core` has no explicit private ACL. `has_function_privilege('authenticated', ... ,'EXECUTE')` is TRUE under Supabase legacy default grants. Explicitly revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated access, allow appropriate service role only. Review default table write grants for tester_report_attachments as well: existing REVOKE does not remove inherited authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grants. RPC-only writes should not depend solely on absence of RLS write policies. Same independent ACL probe.
14: 
15: 3. **Secondary attachment URLs are unvalidated.** A valid first image plus image2 URL `https://attacker.invalid/not-a-report.jpg` is accepted. Existing report-row triggers validate the primary URL only. Validate EVERY item's URL/bucket/user/campaign through existing canonical validators before mutations, including pending replacement/resubmission.
16: 
17: 4. **Secondary hashes are unvalidated.** image2 `image_hash='not-a-valid-hash'` is accepted. Validate required dHash format on every attachment, and validate IDs/positions/SHA-256 schema appropriately.
18: 
19: 5. **Thumbnail/full pairing is not checked on secondary items.** image2 can reference image1's thumbnail. Apply `is_valid_report_thumbnail_url` for each full/thumbnail pair.
20: 
21: 6. **Empty attachment array silently retains pending report images.** Plan explicitly distinguishes null=retain from []=invalid. Pending v3 update with [] is accepted. Enforce array length 1..3 whenever array is supplied, across branches; null only means keep existing where allowed.
22: 
23: 7. **Legacy v2 cover update leaves inconsistent report and attachment rows.** After a v3 three-image report, v2 new-primary-image request succeeds, updating tester_reports.screenshot_url but leaving position0 at the old URL. Reject unsupported legacy image edits on a multi-image report, or coherently preserve/synchronize the whole set without dropping secondary images. Exact receipt and replay must remain valid. Independent probe accepts either explicit appropriate rejection or a coherent complete set.
24: 
25: Items 3–7 are independently reproduced in `root-three-image-initial.log`, test `root-three-image-probe.mjs`.
26: 
27: 8. **V3 accepts a missing client request ID.** Expanded three-image probe supplies no p_client_submit_id and update succeeds, bypassing the durable identity/receipt contract. Require non-null request identity on v2/v3 as appropriate to existing explicit-context API, while preserving the separately documented legacy endpoint compatibility. Evidence `root-three-image-expanded.log`. The same expanded test confirms direct client report_date movement is already blocked; keep that guard working.
28: 
29: 9. **Admin queue overload breaks existing production API calls.** Latest-chain `run-admin-expansion-integration-test.mjs` fails with SQL 42725 on `select public.admin_get_tester_reports_queue(p_status=>null)`: old 8-parameter and new 7-parameter overloads both match. Keep existing published signature/return contract (cursor IDs, has-more, financial/media metadata etc.) while adding attachments; avoid default-argument overload ambiguity. Root evidence `root-admin-chain-initial.log`.
30: 
31: ## Additional review still needed
32: 
33: - Verify new queue returns attachments through the exact endpoint invoked by existing app callers, not only a differently named/new overload tested in isolation.
34: - Pending/rejected mission updates check snapshot deadline but need review of current mission paused/stopped/deleted/deadline changes; keep committed replay semantics. Do not silently relax current eligibility.
35: - Root checklist `root-review-checklist.md` covers downstream gallery/descriptor/grants/durable queue/ordinary quota and mission settlement. Full Android/UI implementation is still required; passing backend probes alone is not completion.

(End of file - total 35 lines)

-- 5. Updated read RPCs: get_campaign_detail, get_campaign_reports_for_owner, admin_get_tester_reports_queue.

-- 1. Add report_date to tester_reports
ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);

UPDATE public.tester_reports
SET report_date = (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
WHERE report_date IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports
    ALTER COLUMN report_date SET NOT NULL;

-- Partial unique indexes: 1 report/day for app_test, 1 report/day per mission for mission
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_reports_daily_app_test
    ON public.tester_reports (user_id, campaign_id, report_date)
    WHERE submission_context = 'app_test';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_reports_daily_mission
    ON public.tester_reports (user_id, campaign_id, mission_id, report_date)
    WHERE submission_context = 'mission';

-- 2. Create tester_report_attachments table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.tester_report_attachments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    report_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tester_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
    screenshot_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    image_hash TEXT,
    sha256 TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(report_id, position)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tester_report_attachments_report_id
    ON public.tester_report_attachments (report_id, position);

ALTER TABLE public.tester_report_attachments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments;
CREATE POLICY "attachments_select_via_report" ON public.tester_report_attachments
AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.tester_reports r
        WHERE r.id = tester_report_attachments.report_id
          AND (
              (r.user_id = auth.uid())
              OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.campaigns c WHERE c.id = r.campaign_id AND c.owner_id = auth.uid()))
              OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND lower(p.role) = 'admin' AND coalesce(p.is_locked, false) = false))
          )
    )
);

REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;
GRANT SELECT ON public.tester_report_attachments TO authenticated;
GRANT ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments TO service_role;

-- 3. Core Submission Logic Function supporting v2 and v3
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(
    p_submission_context text,
    p_campaign_id uuid,
    p_content text,
    p_rating integer,
    p_client_submit_id uuid,
    p_screenshot_url text,
    p_image_hash text,
    p_thumbnail_url text,
    p_mission_id uuid,
    p_attachments jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
    p_expected_date date DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_report_id uuid;
    v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;
    v_camp record;
    v_existing_report record;
    v_idempotent_report record;
    v_receipt record;
    v_fingerprint text;
    v_already_checked_in boolean := false;
    v_status text := 'pending';
    v_rating int := greatest(1, least(5, coalesce(p_rating, 5)));
    v_new_balance int;
    v_provisional_granted boolean := false;
    v_provisional_amount int := 0;
    v_provisional_reward int := 10;
    v_policy public.business_policies;
    v_regrant int := 0;
    v_new_screenshot boolean := false;
    v_effective_full text;
    v_final_url text;
    v_final_hash text;
    v_final_thumb text;

    -- Mission context variables
    v_mission record;
    v_mp record;
    v_submission_context text;
    v_target_mission_id uuid := null;
    v_target_mp_id uuid := null;
    v_target_title text := null;
    v_target_reward int := null;
    v_target_ends_at timestamptz := null;
    v_res_context text;
    v_res_mission_id uuid;
    v_res_title text;
    v_res_reward int;
    v_res_ends_at timestamptz;
    v_result jsonb;

    -- Attachments variables
    v_att_canonical text := '';
    v_att_count int := 0;
    v_att_item jsonb;
    v_att_elem record;
    v_attachments_json jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_pos int;
begin
    v_policy := public._get_effective_business_policy_row(v_today);
    v_provisional_reward := v_policy.report_provisional_reward;

    if v_user_id is null then
        raise exception 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED';
    end if;

    -- Normalize submission context
    v_submission_context := coalesce(p_submission_context, case when p_mission_id is null then 'app_test' else 'mission' end);
    if v_submission_context not in ('app_test', 'mission') then
        raise exception 'INVALID_SUBMISSION_CONTEXT';
    end if;

    if v_submission_context = 'mission' and p_mission_id is null then
        raise exception 'MISSION_ID_REQUIRED';
    end if;
    if v_submission_context = 'app_test' and p_mission_id is not null then
        raise exception 'MISSION_ID_NOT_ALLOWED';
    end if;

    -- Precondition: if expected_date is supplied, check whether today matches
    -- (committed replay is allowed to pass even if across date)
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_user_id::text || ':' || p_client_submit_id::text, 64));
    end if;

    if exists(select 1 from public.report_cancelled_requests where user_id=v_user_id and client_submit_id=p_client_submit_id) then
        raise exception 'REPORT_REQUEST_REQUIRES_REVIEW';
    end if;

    -- Validate attachments array if provided
    if p_attachments is not null then
        if jsonb_typeof(p_attachments) <> 'array' then
            raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_MUST_BE_ARRAY';
        end if;
        v_att_count := jsonb_array_length(p_attachments);
        if v_att_count > 3 then
            raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS';
        end if;
        if v_att_count > 0 then
            -- Verify positions are contiguous 0..count-1
            for v_pos in 0 .. (v_att_count - 1) loop
                v_att_item := p_attachments->v_pos;
                if coalesce((v_att_item->>'position')::int, -1) <> v_pos then
                    raise exception 'ATTACHMENT_POSITION_INVALID';
                end if;
                if v_att_item->>'screenshot_url' is null or btrim(v_att_item->>'screenshot_url') = '' then
                    raise exception 'SCREENSHOT_URL_REQUIRED';
                end if;
                if v_att_item->>'image_hash' is null or btrim(v_att_item->>'image_hash') = '' then
                    raise exception 'IMAGE_HASH_REQUIRED';
                end if;
            end loop;

            select string_agg(
                format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s:%s',
                    coalesce(att->>'id', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'position', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'screenshot_url', ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'thumbnail_url', ''),
                    coalesce(lower(att->>'image_hash'), ''),
                    coalesce(att->>'sha256', '')
                ),
                ',' order by (att->>'position')::int
            ) into v_att_canonical
            from jsonb_array_elements(p_attachments) as att;
        end if;
    end if;

    -- Compute payload fingerprint
    if p_attachments is not null then
        v_fingerprint := encode(digest(format('v3|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
            p_campaign_id,
            v_submission_context,
            coalesce(p_mission_id::text, ''),
            coalesce(p_content, ''),
            v_rating,
            coalesce(v_att_canonical, ''),
            coalesce(p_expected_date::text, '')
        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');
    else
        v_fingerprint := encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
            p_campaign_id,
            coalesce(p_content, ''),
            coalesce(p_screenshot_url, ''),
            coalesce(p_rating, 5),
            coalesce(lower(p_image_hash), ''),
            coalesce(p_thumbnail_url, ''),
            coalesce(p_mission_id::text, '')
        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');
    end if;

    -- Idempotency check via receipt ledger
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        select * into v_receipt
        from public.report_submission_receipts
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_receipt.id is not null then
            if v_receipt.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_fingerprint then
                return v_receipt.response_json;
            end if;

            if v_receipt.provenance = 'legacy_backfill' then
                declare
                    v_resp_mission text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'mission_id', '');
                    v_resp_url text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'screenshot_url', '');
                    v_resp_hash text := coalesce(lower(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'image_hash'), '');
                    v_resp_thumb text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'thumbnail_url', '');
                    v_resp_status text := coalesce(v_receipt.response_json ->> 'status', '');
                    v_eff_mission text := case when p_mission_id is null then v_resp_mission else p_mission_id::text end;
                    v_eff_url text := case when p_screenshot_url is null then v_resp_url else p_screenshot_url end;
                    v_eff_hash text := case when p_image_hash is null then v_resp_hash else lower(p_image_hash) end;
                    v_eff_thumb text := case when p_thumbnail_url is null then v_resp_thumb else p_thumbnail_url end;
                    v_eff_rating int;
                    v_legacy_fp text;
                begin
                    if v_resp_status = 'approved' then
                        select rating into v_eff_rating from public.tester_reports where id = v_receipt.report_id;
                        if v_eff_rating is null then
                            v_eff_rating := coalesce((v_receipt.response_json ->> 'rating')::int, 5);
                        end if;
                    else
                        v_eff_rating := coalesce(p_rating, 5);
                    end if;

                    if (p_screenshot_url is null or p_screenshot_url = v_resp_url)
                       and (p_image_hash is null or lower(p_image_hash) = v_resp_hash)
                       and (p_thumbnail_url is null or p_thumbnail_url = v_resp_thumb)
                       and (p_mission_id is null or p_mission_id::text = v_resp_mission)
                       and (v_resp_status = 'approved' or p_rating is null or p_rating = v_eff_rating)
                    then
                        v_legacy_fp := encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
                            p_campaign_id,
                            coalesce(p_content, ''),
                            v_eff_url,
                            v_eff_rating,
                            v_eff_hash,
                            v_eff_thumb,
                            v_eff_mission
                        ), 'sha256'), 'hex');

                        if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_legacy_fp then
                            return v_receipt.response_json;
                        end if;
                    end if;
                end;
            end if;

            raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
        end if;

        -- Fallback check tester_reports for legacy submissions
        select * into v_idempotent_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_idempotent_report.id is not null then
            if v_idempotent_report.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_mission_id is not null and v_idempotent_report.mission_id is distinct from p_mission_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if coalesce(v_idempotent_report.content, '') <> coalesce(p_content, '') then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_rating is not null and v_idempotent_report.rating is not null and v_idempotent_report.rating <> v_rating then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_image_hash is not null and v_idempotent_report.image_hash is not null and lower(v_idempotent_report.image_hash) <> lower(p_image_hash) then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if p_screenshot_url is not null and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url is not null and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url <> p_screenshot_url then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
            end if;

            -- Attachments from tester_report_attachments or fallback
            select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', a.id,
                'position', a.position,
                'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
                'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
                'image_hash', a.image_hash,
                'sha256', a.sha256
            ) order by a.position), '[]'::jsonb) into v_attachments_json
            from public.tester_report_attachments a
            where a.report_id = v_idempotent_report.id;

            if jsonb_array_length(v_attachments_json) = 0 and v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url is not null then
                v_attachments_json := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', v_idempotent_report.id,
                    'position', 0,
                    'screenshot_url', v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url,
                    'thumbnail_url', v_idempotent_report.thumbnail_url,
                    'image_hash', v_idempotent_report.image_hash,
                    'sha256', null
                ));
            end if;

            v_result := jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'report_id', v_idempotent_report.id,
                'status', v_idempotent_report.status,
                'provisional_granted', false,
                'provisional_amount', 0,
                'screenshot_url', v_idempotent_report.screenshot_url,
                'image_hash', v_idempotent_report.image_hash,
                'thumbnail_url', v_idempotent_report.thumbnail_url,
                'submission_context', v_idempotent_report.submission_context,
                'mission_id', v_idempotent_report.mission_id,
                'mission_title', v_idempotent_report.mission_title,
                'mission_reward_credits', v_idempotent_report.mission_reward_credits,
                'mission_ends_at', to_char(v_idempotent_report.mission_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'rating', v_idempotent_report.rating,
                'report_date', to_char(v_idempotent_report.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                'attachments', v_attachments_json
            );

            insert into public.report_submission_receipts (
                user_id, client_submit_id, campaign_id, report_id,
                payload_fingerprint, response_json, created_at, provenance
            ) values (
                v_user_id, p_client_submit_id, p_campaign_id, v_idempotent_report.id,
                v_fingerprint, v_result, now(), 'exact_v1'

    -- Date precondition check for uncommitted submissions
    if p_expected_date is not null and p_expected_date <> v_today then
        raise exception 'REPORT_DATE_MISMATCH: Ngay bao cao du kien khong khop voi may chu';

    end if;

        where id = v_user_id and is_locked = true

        raise exception 'CAMPAIGN_NOT_OPEN';
    end if;

    -- Lock contextually by (user, campaign, context, mission, date)
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(format('%s:%s:%s:%s:%s', v_user_id, p_campaign_id, v_submission_context, coalesce(p_mission_id::text, ''), v_today), 0)
    );

    -- Re-check receipt ledger under lock
    if p_client_submit_id is not null then
        select * into v_receipt
        from public.report_submission_receipts
        where user_id = v_user_id
          and client_submit_id = p_client_submit_id
        limit 1;

        if v_receipt.id is not null then
            if v_receipt.campaign_id <> p_campaign_id then
                raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_MISMATCH';
            end if;
            if v_receipt.payload_fingerprint = v_fingerprint then
                return v_receipt.response_json;
            end if;
            raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH';
        end if;
    end if;

    insert into public.campaign_members (campaign_id, user_id)
    values (p_campaign_id, v_user_id)
    on conflict (campaign_id, user_id) do nothing;

    -- Lookup existing report for today strictly within the same context and mission
    if v_submission_context = 'mission' then
        select * into v_existing_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and user_id = v_user_id
          and submission_context = 'mission'
          and mission_id = p_mission_id
          and report_date = v_today
        order by created_at desc
        limit 1
        for update;
    else
        select * into v_existing_report
        from public.tester_reports
        where campaign_id = p_campaign_id
          and user_id = v_user_id
          and submission_context = 'app_test'
          and report_date = v_today
        order by created_at desc
        limit 1
        for update;
    end if;

    -- Backfill legacy receipt before client_submit_id gets overwritten
    if v_existing_report.id is not null
       and v_existing_report.client_submit_id is not null
       and v_existing_report.client_submit_id is distinct from p_client_submit_id then
        insert into public.report_submission_receipts (
            user_id, client_submit_id, campaign_id, report_id,
            payload_fingerprint, response_json, created_at, provenance
        ) values (
            v_user_id,
            v_existing_report.client_submit_id,
            p_campaign_id,
            v_existing_report.id,
            encode(digest(format('%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s',
                p_campaign_id,
                coalesce(v_existing_report.content, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.screenshot_url, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.rating, 5),
                coalesce(lower(v_existing_report.image_hash), ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.thumbnail_url, ''),
                coalesce(v_existing_report.mission_id::text, '')
            ), 'sha256'), 'hex'),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'report_id', v_existing_report.id,
                'status', v_existing_report.status,
                'provisional_granted', false,
                'provisional_amount', 0,
                'screenshot_url', v_existing_report.screenshot_url,
                'image_hash', v_existing_report.image_hash,
                'thumbnail_url', v_existing_report.thumbnail_url,
                'submission_context', v_existing_report.submission_context,
                'mission_id', v_existing_report.mission_id,
                'mission_title', v_existing_report.mission_title,
                'mission_reward_credits', v_existing_report.mission_reward_credits,
                'mission_ends_at', to_char(v_existing_report.mission_ends_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'rating', v_existing_report.rating,
                'report_date', to_char(v_existing_report.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            ),
            v_existing_report.created_at,
            'legacy_backfill'
        ) on conflict (user_id, client_submit_id) do nothing;
    end if;

    -- Disallow mutating an existing report to another context or mission
    if v_existing_report.id is not null and (
        v_existing_report.submission_context is distinct from v_submission_context
        or v_existing_report.mission_id is distinct from p_mission_id
    ) then
        raise exception 'REPORT_CONTEXT_CONFLICT';
    end if;

1625: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_tester_reports_queue(
1626:     p_status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text,
1627:     p_campaign_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
1628:     p_tester_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
1629:     p_owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
1630:     p_submission_context text DEFAULT NULL::text,
1631:     p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
1632:     p_cursor_created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL::timestamptz,
1633:     p_cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
1634: )
1635: RETURNS jsonb
1636: LANGUAGE plpgsql
1637: SECURITY DEFINER
1638: SET search_path TO 'public'
1639: AS $function$
1640: declare
1641:     v_caller_id uuid;
1642:     v_limit int;
1643:     v_rows jsonb;
1644:     v_has_more boolean := false;
1645:     v_next_cursor jsonb := null;
1646:     v_count int;
1647: begin
1648:     if exists (select 1 from pg_proc where proname = 'assert_unlocked_admin' and pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace) then
1649:         v_caller_id := public.assert_unlocked_admin();
1650:     else
1651:         v_caller_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();
1652:     end if;
1653:     v_limit := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 100));
1654: 
1655:     with raw_reports as (
1656:         select
1657:             tr.id,
1658:             tr.campaign_id,
1659:             c.app_name as campaign_name,
1660:             c.package_name,
1661:             c.owner_id,
1662:             po.display_name as owner_name,
1663:             tr.user_id as tester_id,
1664:             pt.display_name as tester_name,
1665:             pt.email as tester_email,
1666:             tr.report_type,
1667:             tr.content,
1668:             tr.screenshot_url,
1669:             tr.thumbnail_url,
1670:             tr.media_expired,
1671:             tr.rating,
1672:             tr.status,
1673:             tr.submission_context,
1674:             tr.mission_title,
1675:             tr.created_at,
1676:             tr.reviewed_at,
1677:             tr.rejection_reason,
1678:             tr.review_tester_bonus,
1679:             tr.review_owner_bonus,
1680:             tr.business_policy_id,
1681:             tr.provisional_granted_credits,
1682:             tr.provisional_clawed,
1683:             tr.bonus_awarded,
1684:             to_char(tr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as report_date,
1685:             coalesce((
1686:                 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
1687:                     'id', a.id,
1688:                     'position', a.position,
1689:                     'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
1690:                     'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
1691:                     'image_hash', a.image_hash,
1692:                     'sha256', a.sha256
1693:                 ) order by a.position)
1694:                 from public.tester_report_attachments a
1695:                 where a.report_id = tr.id
1696:             ), case when tr.screenshot_url is not null then jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
1697:                 'id', tr.id,
1698:                 'position', 0,
1699:                 'screenshot_url', tr.screenshot_url,
1700:                 'thumbnail_url', tr.thumbnail_url,
1701:                 'image_hash', tr.image_hash,
1702:                 'sha256', null
1703:             )) else '[]'::jsonb end) as attachments
1704:         from public.tester_reports tr
1705:         inner join public.campaigns c on c.id = tr.campaign_id
1706:         left join public.profiles po on po.id = c.owner_id
1707:         left join public.profiles pt on pt.id = tr.user_id
1708:         where (p_cursor_created_at is null or (tr.created_at, tr.id) < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id))
1709:           and (p_status is null or tr.status = p_status)
1710:           and (p_campaign_id is null or tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id)
1711:           and (p_tester_id is null or tr.user_id = p_tester_id)
1712:           and (p_owner_id is null or c.owner_id = p_owner_id)
1713:           and (p_submission_context is null or tr.submission_context = p_submission_context)
1714:         order by tr.created_at desc, tr.id desc
1715:         limit v_limit + 1
1716:     )
1717:     select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), count(*)
1718:     into v_rows, v_count
1719:     from raw_reports r;
1720: 
1721:     if v_count > v_limit then
1722:         v_has_more := true;
1723:         select jsonb_agg(elem)
1724:         into v_rows

    p_tester_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
    p_owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid,
    p_submission_context text DEFAULT NULL::text,
    p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
    p_cursor_created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL::timestamptz,
    p_cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_caller_id uuid;
    v_limit int;
    v_rows jsonb;
    v_has_more boolean := false;
    v_next_cursor jsonb := null;
    v_count int;
begin
    if exists (select 1 from pg_proc where proname = 'assert_unlocked_admin' and pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace) then
        v_caller_id := public.assert_unlocked_admin();
    else
        v_caller_id := public._assert_daily_task_admin();
    end if;
    v_limit := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 100));

    with raw_reports as (
        select
            tr.id,
            tr.campaign_id,
            c.app_name as campaign_name,
            c.package_name,
            c.owner_id,
            po.display_name as owner_name,
            tr.user_id as tester_id,
            pt.display_name as tester_name,
            pt.email as tester_email,
            tr.report_type,
            tr.content,
            tr.screenshot_url,
            tr.thumbnail_url,
            tr.media_expired,
            tr.rating,
            tr.status,
            tr.submission_context,
            tr.mission_title,
            tr.created_at,
            tr.reviewed_at,
            tr.rejection_reason,
            tr.review_tester_bonus,
            tr.review_owner_bonus,
            tr.business_policy_id,
            tr.provisional_granted_credits,
            tr.provisional_clawed,
            tr.bonus_awarded,
            to_char(tr.report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as report_date,
            coalesce((
                select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', a.id,
                    'position', a.position,
                    'screenshot_url', a.screenshot_url,
                    'thumbnail_url', a.thumbnail_url,
                    'image_hash', a.image_hash,
                    'sha256', a.sha256
                ) order by a.position)
                from public.tester_report_attachments a
                where a.report_id = tr.id
            ), case when tr.screenshot_url is not null then jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', tr.id,
                'position', 0,
                'screenshot_url', tr.screenshot_url,
                'thumbnail_url', tr.thumbnail_url,
                'image_hash', tr.image_hash,
                'sha256', null
            )) else '[]'::jsonb end) as attachments
        from public.tester_reports tr
        inner join public.campaigns c on c.id = tr.campaign_id
        left join public.profiles po on po.id = c.owner_id
        left join public.profiles pt on pt.id = tr.user_id
        where (p_cursor_created_at is null or (tr.created_at, tr.id) < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id))
          and (p_status is null or tr.status = p_status)
          and (p_campaign_id is null or tr.campaign_id = p_campaign_id)
          and (p_tester_id is null or tr.user_id = p_tester_id)
          and (p_owner_id is null or c.owner_id = p_owner_id)
          and (p_submission_context is null or tr.submission_context = p_submission_context)
        order by tr.created_at desc, tr.id desc
        limit v_limit + 1
    )
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), count(*)
    into v_rows, v_count
    from raw_reports r;

    if v_count > v_limit then
        v_has_more := true;
        select jsonb_agg(elem)
        into v_rows
        from (
            select elem
            from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) with ordinality as t(elem, ord)
            where ord <= v_limit
        ) sub;

        v_next_cursor := jsonb_build_object(
            'created_at', v_rows->(v_limit - 1)->>'created_at',
            'id', v_rows->(v_limit - 1)->>'id'
        );
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'items', coalesce(v_rows, '[]'::jsonb),
        'has_more', v_has_more,
        'next_cursor', v_next_cursor
    );
end;

6296: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_valid_report_screenshot_url(p_url text, p_campaign_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
6297:  RETURNS boolean
6298:  LANGUAGE plpgsql
6299:  IMMUTABLE
6300: AS $function$
6301: declare
6302:     v_clean_url text;
6303:     v_bucket text;
6304:     v_path text;
6305:     v_matches text[];
6306: begin
6307:     if p_url is null or length(p_url) > 2048 then
6308:         return false;
6309:     end if;
6310: 
6311:     -- Tách query string (?) và fragment (#) để triệt tiêu query spoofing
6312:     v_clean_url := split_part(split_part(p_url, '?', 1), '#', 1);
6313: 
6314:     -- 1. Parse theo định dạng Firebase Storage chuẩn hoặc GCS
6315:     if v_clean_url ~* '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
6316:         v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
6317:         v_bucket := v_matches[1];
6318:         v_path := v_matches[2];
6319:     elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
6320:         v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
6321:         v_bucket := v_matches[2];
6322:         v_path := v_matches[3];
6323:     elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$' then
6324:         v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$', 'i');
6325:         v_bucket := v_matches[1] || '.firebasestorage.app';
6326:         v_path := v_matches[2];
6327:     elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$' then
6328:         v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$', 'i');
6329:         v_bucket := v_matches[1];
6330:         v_path := v_matches[2];
6331:     else
6332:         return false;
6333:     end if;
6334: 
6335:     -- 2. Allowlist bucket (chỉ cho phép các bucket chính thức của dự án, không cho phép ký tự đại diện hoặc bucket test trong validator production)
6336:     if not (
6337:         v_bucket in ('cross-testers.firebasestorage.app', 'cross-testers.appspot.com', 'crosstest-prod.appspot.com')
6338:     ) then
6339:         return false;
6340:     end if;
6341: 
6342:     -- 3. Chuẩn hoá percent-encoding (%2F -> /)
6343:     v_path := replace(replace(v_path, '%2F', '/'), '%2f', '/');
6344: 
6345:     -- 4. Ràng buộc object path: reports/<campaign_id>/<user_id>/<filename>
6346:     if not (
6347:         v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
6348:         or v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '_[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
6349:     ) then
6350:         return false;
6351:     end if;
6352: 
6353:     return true;
6354: end;

    if v_clean_url ~* '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://firebasestorage\.googleapis\.com/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1];
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/v0/b/([^/]+)/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[2];
        v_path := v_matches[3];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://([^/]+)\.firebasestorage\.app/o/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1] || '.firebasestorage.app';
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    elsif v_clean_url ~* '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$' then
        v_matches := regexp_matches(v_clean_url, '^https://storage\.googleapis\.com/([^/]+)/(.+)$', 'i');
        v_bucket := v_matches[1];
        v_path := v_matches[2];
    else
        return false;
    end if;

    -- 2. Allowlist bucket (chỉ cho phép các bucket chính thức của dự án, không cho phép ký tự đại diện hoặc bucket test trong validator production)
    if not (
        v_bucket in ('cross-testers.firebasestorage.app', 'cross-testers.appspot.com', 'crosstest-prod.appspot.com')
    ) then
        return false;
    end if;

    -- 3. Chuẩn hoá percent-encoding (%2F -> /)
    v_path := replace(replace(v_path, '%2F', '/'), '%2f', '/');

    -- 4. Ràng buộc object path: reports/<campaign_id>/<user_id>/<filename>
    if not (
        v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
        or v_path ~* ('^reports/' || p_campaign_id::text || '/' || p_user_id::text || '_[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
    ) then
        return false;
    end if;

    return true;
end;

## 2. Issues Investigated & Corrected

### Defect 1: `report_date` DEFAULT backfill corrupted historical rows
- **Root Cause**: `ALTER TABLE public.tester_reports ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS report_date date DEFAULT ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);` backfilled every historical row with today's date in Postgres, making the subsequent `WHERE report_date IS NULL` a no-op and causing unique index violation 23505 on multiple historical days.
- **Fix**: Added column without default, backfilled from `(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date WHERE report_date IS NULL`, then set default and `NOT NULL`.

### Defect 2: `_submit_tester_report_core` lacked private ACL
- **Root Cause**: `_submit_tester_report_core` had default execution grant to `PUBLIC`/`authenticated` under Supabase default grants.
- **Fix**: Added `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._submit_tester_report_core(...) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ... TO service_role;`.

### Defect 3: `tester_report_attachments` inherited write grants
- **Root Cause**: `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, PUBLIC;` omitted `authenticated`, leaving inherited DML write grants active.
- **Fix**: Executed `REVOKE ALL ON public.tester_report_attachments FROM anon, authenticated, PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT ... TO authenticated; GRANT ALL ... TO service_role;`. Added check constraint `CHECK (image_hash IS NULL OR lower(image_hash) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$')`.

### Defect 4: Missing v3 client request ID accepted
- **Root Cause**: `p_client_submit_id` defaulted to NULL and was not required in v2/v3 endpoints.
- **Fix**: Enforced `if p_client_submit_id is null then raise exception 'CLIENT_SUBMIT_ID_REQUIRED'; end if;` in `submit_tester_report_v2`, `submit_tester_report_v3`, and `_submit_tester_report_core` (when `p_attachments is not null`), preserving legacy `submit_tester_report` compatibility.

### Defect 5 & 6: Secondary attachment URLs, hashes, and thumbnail pairs unvalidated
- **Root Cause**: Validation only occurred via row triggers on primary screenshot fields in `tester_reports`. Secondary attachments in `p_attachments` were inserted into `tester_report_attachments` without checks.
- **Fix**: Enforced per-item validation across all attachments in `_submit_tester_report_core`:
  - `is_valid_report_screenshot_url(att->>'screenshot_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id)`
  - `lower(att->>'image_hash') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'`
  - `is_valid_report_thumbnail_url(att->>'thumbnail_url', p_campaign_id, v_user_id, att->>'screenshot_url')`

### Defect 7: Empty attachment array `[]` accepted
- **Root Cause**: `if v_att_count > 0` bypassed checks for `v_att_count = 0`, retaining existing attachments silently.
- **Fix**: Enforced `if v_att_count < 1 then raise exception 'ATTACHMENTS_EMPTY...'; end if;` and `if v_att_count > 3 then raise exception 'TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS'; end if;`.

### Defect 8: Legacy v2 cover update incoherent on multi-image report
- **Root Cause**: When updating an existing report with `v_new_screenshot` via v2, `tester_reports.screenshot_url` was updated but `tester_report_attachments` was ignored when `p_attachments` was NULL.
- **Fix**: Added synchronization of position 0 in `tester_report_attachments` with new cover URL/hash and cleared `sha256 = null`, while fully preserving positions 1 and 2.

### Defect 9: Fingerprint delimiter collision
- **Root Cause**: `v_att_canonical` used `:` delimiter concatenation, allowing `full + ':' + thumb` vs `thumb + ':' + thumb` to produce identical fingerprints.
- **Fix**: Generated `v_att_canonical` via `jsonb_agg` ordered by position, guaranteeing distinct and tamper-proof fingerprints.

### Defect 10: Admin queue overload ambiguity
- **Verification**: Verified `admin_get_tester_reports_queue` retains its published 8-parameter signature with full backward compatibility and attachment inclusion.

+### 1.1 Cửa sổ báo cáo nhiệm vụ riêng (Dedicated Full-Screen Mission Window)
+- **Điểm vào và điều hướng**:
+  - Tạo route riêng `mission_report/{campaignId}/{missionId}` trong `NavGraph.kt`.
+  - Bấm vào mission card, dòng app hay nút hành động trong `QuestsScreen` và `HomeScreen` đều điều hướng trực tiếp tới cửa sổ nhiệm vụ riêng với đúng `campaignId` và `missionId`.
+  - Khôi phục route cũ có `missionId` trong `campaign/{campaignId}?missionId={missionId}` tự động chuyển tiếp tới cửa sổ nhiệm vụ riêng. Điểm vào test app hằng ngày thông thường (`campaign/{campaignId}`) giữ nguyên độc lập.
+- **Hai nút trên cùng (Side by side)**:
+  - **Mở app**: Sử dụng intent launcher package của campaign (`packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage`). Chỉ ghi nhận bắt đầu tính thời gian test khi mở thành công. Nếu thiết bị chưa cài đặt ứng dụng, hiển thị thông báo hướng dẫn người dùng bấm nút "Link Play Store".
+  - **Link Play Store**: Mở Google Play Store thông qua `market://details?id=...` (ưu tiên package `com.android.vending`), có cơ chế dự phòng an toàn mở link testing / play store qua trình duyệt.
+- **Biểu mẫu "Báo cáo nhiệm vụ app" inline**:
+  - Nhập nhận xét, đánh giá chất lượng (1–5 sao).
+  - Tích hợp sẵn nút "Nhận nhiệm vụ" nếu tester chưa tham gia nhiệm vụ trước khi cho phép gửi.

+### 1.4 Hàng đợi gửi nền bền vững (Durable Queue & Crash Recovery)
+- Mở rộng `PendingReport` và `PendingReportStore` hỗ trợ `PendingAttachment` danh sách nhiều ảnh với vị trí, SHA-256 fingerprint, đường dẫn local và thumbnail.
+- Worker `ReportUploadWorker` tải ảnh lên Firebase Storage tuần tự và ghi checkpoint `markAttachmentUploaded` ngay sau từng ảnh thành công. Nếu gặp sự cố mạng hoặc process bị kill, lần thử tiếp theo sẽ bỏ qua ảnh đã tải xong và tiếp tục phần chưa hoàn tất mà không cần nén hay tải lại từ đầu.
+- Gọi RPC nguyên tử `submit_tester_report_v3` với đầy đủ bộ ảnh và receipt snapshot bất biến.
+- Đổi khóa admission lock và trạng thái trong `ReportSubmitManager` sang `(userId, campaignId, context, missionId, reportDate)`, không để báo cáo thường và nhiệm vụ chặn nhau hoặc ghi đè trạng thái.
+- Điều chỉnh `pendingCampaignIds(context, contextFilter)` để nhiệm vụ đang chờ gửi không loại trừ gợi ý app cho bài test thường.
+
+### 1.5 Nhãn nhận diện, bộ lọc và thư viện ảnh phía Chủ app & Quản trị viên
+- Badge hiển thị: Bắt buộc nhãn **Báo cáo nhiệm vụ app**, kèm tên nhiệm vụ và ngày báo cáo.
+- Bộ lọc chủ app (`OwnerAppDetailScreen`): Phân loại rõ ràng "Tất cả", "Báo cáo thường", "Báo cáo nhiệm vụ app".
+- Hiển thị toàn bộ bộ ảnh (1..3 ảnh) trong gallery thay vì chỉ hiển thị ảnh đại diện đầu tiên.
+- Quản trị viên (`AdminTesterReportsQueueScreen`): hiển thị toàn bộ attachments và gắn nhãn nhiệm vụ rõ ràng.
+- Media Access Gateway (`media-gateway-handler.mjs` & `supabase-authority-adapter.mjs`): Mở rộng hợp đồng tiếp nhận tham số `attachment_id`, kiểm tra grant token và trả về đúng storage path của attachment được yêu cầu.

+# Coordinator Android review — initial implementation, not yet acceptance
+
+Primary Gemini is still implementing/compiling Android. Re-check latest source before fixing; some points may be addressed by later primary edits. Do not treat passing SQL probes as Android completion. Root added 7 meaningful independent Android tests in this audit/independent-tests, enabled by independent.init.gradle (also retains the prior13 audit tests). These have NOT been run yet because main source is mid-edit; compile first, then run and preserve every assertion.
+
+## Confirmed source/API defect
+
+1. MissionReportScreen constructs PickMultipleVisualMedia(maxItems=(3-prepared.size).coerceAtLeast(1)). At prepared.size2 or3 it constructs maxItems1 and crashes during composition. Pinned Activity1.13.0 source explicitly requires maxItems>1 (local evidence picker-contract-source-evidence.txt). Use separate single-image launcher when one slot remains, valid multiple contract otherwise; no contract1 even on a full/disabled grid. Verify selecting two photos and adding the third never closes the window. Official reference: https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/activity/result/contract/ActivityResultContracts.PickMultipleVisualMedia
+
+## Required behavioral/contract review
+
+2. **Durable draft and account/day identity.** Initial MissionReportViewModel only saves comment/rating to SavedStateHandle, with keys missing user/date. No file metadata is saved to a durable draft store; navigation pop/reopen loses the entire draft, and process recreation cannot restore image files. Admission clears SavedStateHandle before server receipt, while new draft changes/leases are not versioned. Implement the planned private durable draft store scoped user/campaign/mission/reportDate, restore image+thumb/hash metadata, protect files still referenced, keep user edits after snapshot, clear only matching successful snapshot, and do not mix old account/day. Navigation SavedStateHandle alone does not retain a popped route. If only preserving across rotation, do not claim full draft implementation.
+
+3. **Ordinary/mission submit-state interference.** Initial publishState still writes EVERY kind into campaignStates[campaignId], and ordinary CampaignDetailViewModel subscribes to stateForCampaign(campaignId). New admission locks allow both, but ordinary screen can still see mission SENDING/reward/result and block its own report. Scope consumers as well as locks; ordinary page must observe ordinary scope, mission page exact user/mission/day. Test both work orders with real delayed WorkManager workers.
+
+4. **Logout/day scope leaks.** Initial cancelAllPendingWork clears campaignStates but not scopedStates. stateForMission/currentStateForMission selects first matching campaign+mission across any user/day, so yesterday's DONE state or previous account's result can be selected. Initial/failed executeAdmission publications also omit scopedKey/context/missionId. Make all state lifecycle paths use exact immutable scope and clear all scoped state on logout. Freeze date when request is accepted; nullable expectedDate must not recompute active-map keys across midnight.
+
+5. **Opening/testing guard.** Initial VM changed ordinary minimum10sec to60sec and neither submitReport nor submit-button enablement checks testStartedAt/minimum remaining time. New mission report can submit without opening app. Reuse existing10sec validation semantics, enforce in VM admission (not button alone), record start only on actual app launch, keep Play Store separate. Pending/approved comment updates follow existing exemptions; do not require a new test for a pure approved comment update.
+
+6. **Screenshot cache/expiry/gateway contract.** Initial mission screen uses raw AsyncImage(url) for saved attachments and full preview, without ScreenshotDescriptor/report createdAt/mediaExpired/exact attachment ID. Existing ScreenshotCoilInterceptor reads descriptor tags for expiry and gateway; raw URLs lose trusted metadata. Use shared ScreenshotRequestFactory/image viewer for every remote image with that attachment's own thumbnail/full/id plus report expiry/account scope. Extend MediaAccessGrantProvider/ScreenshotDescriptor/gateway grant consumer as needed to select image2/3, not first image for every request. For legacy one-image fallback, ReportAttachment.id=report.id is synthetic and cannot be passed as a real attachment UUID to new SQL grant lookup (no matching row). Use the report-primary path for legacy. Keep no-store/default flags unchanged.
+
+7. **Pending/prepared cleanup and budget.** Initial PendingReportStore.cleanup still deletes >48h requests/files despite unresolved WorkManager work and counts legacy primary path PLUS same path in attachments, potentially evicting accepted requests that fit20MiB. PreparedScreenshotCache.cleanup still ignores active leases. Run MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest unchanged; real queued work and leased draft files must survive cleanup. Budget admission should prevent accepting more work instead of deleting active requests. Account for unique physical paths and all thumbs/copies.
+
+8. **Full receipt after WorkManager success.** Initial manager success path reconstructs SubmitTesterReportResult from primary-only WorkManager Data, ignoring completedResult.attachments/reportDate persisted in PendingReportStore, then deletes pending metadata. Prefer full durable receipt before cleanup; summary WorkManager data is insufficient for three-image completion/restart/offline UI. Worker retry tests cover checkpoint/replay, but add manager-consumer coverage too.
+
+9. **Product text and status.** Initial new screen has many hardcoded Vietnamese strings (timer, feedback labels, statuses/errors, retry etc.) and raw server exception messages. Use existing localization/friendly-error infrastructure and synchronized values/values-vi/values-en keys/formats. Make clear whether choosing new photos replaces a pending report's whole existing set; do not silently discard retained images under an 'add' affordance. Keep <=3 total intent, rejected-new-primary rule, approved comment-only updates, and meaningful server-driven statuses/rewards. Enforce current join/deadline rules before submit and handle server races/replay correctly.
+
+## Verification needed after implementation stabilizes
+
+- Run root's independent.init.gradle filters for MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest and MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest (7 tests). Fix implementation, not assertions. Root will separately verify account/day manager state, durable draft reopen, actual picker selection/rendering and per-attachment request descriptors once APIs stabilize.
+- Keep all root SQL23 cases passing; corrective SQL session finished and coordinator independently verified stable074. Do not undo its canonical JSON fingerprint, backfill, private ACL, per-image validation, legacy SHA fix or queue signature compatibility.
+- Ensure new mission-window backend tests are included in final verification/CI path, not only a standalone uninvoked script. Full normal Android + prior13 audit regressions + new independent tests, build APK and full backend suites still required. No commit/push/production operations/version upgrades/secrets.

+

DEFAULT today` backfills every existing row with today; following `UPDATE ... WHERE report_date IS NULL` changes nothing. Explicitly revoke PUBLIC/anon/authenticated access, allow appropriate service role only. RPC-only writes should not depend solely on absence of RLS write policies. Same independent ACL probe.

Existing report-row triggers validate the primary URL only. parts.text:
The query attempts to find today's report, locking the row for classification. The `created_at` timestamp is cast to date in the 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' timezone. The query orders by `created_at` in descending order and limits to one result.


The existing logic prevents submitting `mission` reports if an `app_test` report already exists for the same user, campaign, and date due to the assumption of a single report per day. The new requirement necessitates separating regular and mission reports by day, each with distinct business keys. Regular reports will be identified by (user_id, campaign_id, report_date), and mission reports by (user_id, campaign_id, mission_id, report_date), allowing both report types on the same day.


The resubmission/approval process requires context, mission, and date validation (or reportId with identity/permission check). Limiting to one report for selection is incorrect; a direct report lookup is needed. The shared function with v2 must be updated: even if a mission report exists, the app_test report should still be created/updated correctly. Rejecting v3 reports because a regular report already exists is disallowed, and preventing context/mission modification for created reports remains in effect.


The updated logic needs to search for an existing report using context, mission ID, and report date, removing the limit of 1.  The search strategy depends on the submission context: mission reports are identified by campaign, user, context, mission, and date, while app tests use campaign, user, context, and date. Concurrency locks must be verified to ensure proper row-level locking. Mission participant status updates are critical, particularly regarding approvals and removal of reporting days.  Investigating mission completion and reward handling in existing modules is necessary. RPC parameters have to be scrutinized to see how new calls interact with old ones. Finally, read RPCs must be updated to differentiate between regular and mission reports.


Analyzing components across the gateway, storage cleanup, and Android application reveals the integration points for mission reports with attachments. The Android application introduces new data models for report attachments and submission contexts, along with specific RPC calls. The UI includes a new mission report screen and associated form components, facilitating attachment uploads and submission. The application supports durable storage, per-image checkpoints, and retry logic for up to three attachments, keyed by relevant parameters.

parts.text:
The mission report indicates that participant status was incorrectly set to "completed" upon approval. Investigating the report logic, especially the `approve_tester_report` call. This suggests a potential flaw in how report approvals influence participant state.


Participant completion status, likely driven by a legacy single-report paradigm, is incorrectly influencing subsequent report submissions. The logic needs to distinguish between daily report approvals and overall mission completion to prevent premature status updates and maintain valid submission rights. Examination of the submission process reveals a missing status check, allowing submissions even if the participant appears "completed." This is likely the root cause.


Initial hypothesis: Premature completion status prevents subsequent mission report settlements, specifically in multi-day missions. The logic in `_settle_mission_reward` likely assumes a 'joined' status, but this is incorrectly overridden, preventing settlement. Need to carefully re-examine the product contract to determine the correct multi-day mission settlement behavior.

The product contract explicitly requires independent daily reports, and the logic must accommodate daily submissions, regardless of prior approvals. Approving an early report MUST NOT prevent settlement of subsequent reports within a multi-day mission. The current implementation violates this requirement.


The existing logic erroneously treats the "completed" status as a global state, prematurely terminating a participant's ability to submit daily reports in multi-day missions. The system must permit independent, daily submissions, even if an initial report is approved, to align with the product contract's explicit requirement for daily participation and settlement. The settlement logic needs modification to accommodate daily report approvals within a multi-day mission and should not assume mission completion based on the first approved report.
