class MissionReportViewModel(
    private val campaignId: String,
    private val missionId: String,
    private val repository: CampaignRepository,
    private val reportSubmitManager: ReportSubmitManager,
    private val appContext: Context,
    private val savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle = SavedStateHandle(),
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(MissionReportUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<MissionReportUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private var compressionJob: Job? = null
    private var timerJob: Job? = null

    init {
        restoreDraft()
        loadData()
        observeSubmitState()
    }

    private fun draftKey(field: String): String =
        "draft_${campaignId}_${missionId}_$field"

    private fun restoreDraft() {
        val savedComment = savedStateHandle.get<String>(draftKey("comment"))
        val savedRating = savedStateHandle.get<Int>(draftKey("rating"))
        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(
                comment = savedComment ?: it.comment,
                rating = savedRating ?: it.rating,
            )
        }
    }

    fun loadData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, errorMessage = null) }
            try {
                val camp = repository.getCampaign(campaignId)
                val missionList = repository.getOpenMissions(forceRefresh = true)
                val targetMission = missionList.firstOrNull { it.id == missionId }
                    ?: repository.getCampaignMission(campaignId, missionId)

                val myTodayMissionRep = repository.getMyTodayMissionReport(campaignId, missionId)
                val isJoined = targetMission?.hasJoined == true || myTodayMissionRep != null

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        campaign = camp,
                        mission = targetMission,
                        isJoined = isJoined,
                        todayReport = myTodayMissionRep,
                        rating = myTodayMissionRep?.rating ?: it.rating,
                        comment = if (it.comment.isBlank()) myTodayMissionRep?.content.orEmpty() else it.comment,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, errorMessage = e.message) }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeSubmitState() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            reportSubmitManager.stateForMission(campaignId, missionId).collect { state ->
                _uiState.update { it.copy(submitState = state) }
                if (state?.stage == ReportSubmitManager.Stage.DONE) {
                    // Refresh data to show submitted / approved state
                    loadData()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateRating(newRating: Int) {
        val clamped = newRating.coerceIn(1, 5)
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("rating")] = clamped
        _uiState.update { it.copy(rating = clamped) }
    }

    fun updateComment(newComment: String) {
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("comment")] = newComment
        _uiState.update { it.copy(comment = newComment) }
    }

    val errorMessage: String? = null,
    val infoMessage: String? = null,
    val previewScreenshot: PreparedScreenshot? = null,
    val previewUrl: String? = null,
    val previewAttachmentId: String? = null,
)

class MissionReportViewModel(
    private val campaignId: String,
    private val missionId: String,
    private val repository: CampaignRepository,
    private val reportSubmitManager: ReportSubmitManager,
    private val appContext: Context,
    private val savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle = SavedStateHandle(),
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(MissionReportUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<MissionReportUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private var compressionJob: Job? = null
    private var timerJob: Job? = null

    init {
        restoreDraft()
        loadData()
        observeSubmitState()
    }

    private fun draftKey(field: String): String =
        "draft_${campaignId}_${missionId}_$field"

    private fun restoreDraft() {
        val savedComment = savedStateHandle.get<String>(draftKey("comment"))
        val savedRating = savedStateHandle.get<Int>(draftKey("rating"))
        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(
                comment = savedComment ?: it.comment,
                rating = savedRating ?: it.rating,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun persistDurableDraft() {
        val uid = repository.currentUserId() ?: return
        val state = _uiState.value
        val todayDate = VnTime.todayString()
        val draft = MissionReportDraft(
            userId = uid,
            campaignId = campaignId,
            missionId = missionId,
            reportDate = todayDate,
            rating = state.rating,
            comment = state.comment,
            testStartedAtMs = state.testStartedAtMs,
            preparedImages = state.preparedScreenshots.map {
                DraftAttachment(
                    uploadId = it.uploadId,
                    filePath = it.file.absolutePath,
                    thumbnailPath = it.thumbnailFile?.absolutePath,
                    imageHash = it.imageHash,
                    sizeBytes = it.sizeBytes,
                    contentType = it.contentType,
                )
            }
        )
        MissionReportDraftStore.saveDraft(appContext, draft)
    }

    fun loadData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, errorMessage = null) }
            try {
                val camp = repository.getCampaign(campaignId)
                val missionList = repository.getOpenMissions(forceRefresh = true)
                val targetMission = missionList.firstOrNull { it.id == missionId }
                    ?: repository.getCampaignMission(campaignId, missionId)

                val myTodayMissionRep = repository.getMyTodayMissionReport(campaignId, missionId)
                val isJoined = targetMission?.hasJoined == true || myTodayMissionRep != null
                val uid = repository.currentUserId().orEmpty()
                val todayDate = VnTime.todayString()

                val durableDraft = MissionReportDraftStore.loadDraft(appContext, uid, campaignId, missionId, todayDate)
                val restoredComment = when {
                    durableDraft != null && durableDraft.comment.isNotBlank() -> durableDraft.comment
                    _uiState.value.comment.isNotBlank() -> _uiState.value.comment
                    myTodayMissionRep != null -> myTodayMissionRep.content
                    else -> ""
                }
                val restoredRating = durableDraft?.rating ?: myTodayMissionRep?.rating ?: _uiState.value.rating

                // Restore prepared images from durable draft if files exist
                val restoredScreenshots = mutableListOf<PreparedScreenshot>()
                if (durableDraft != null && durableDraft.preparedImages.isNotEmpty()) {
                    for (dAtt in durableDraft.preparedImages) {
                        val file = File(dAtt.filePath)
                        if (file.isFile) {
                            PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(file.absolutePath)
                            val thumbFile = dAtt.thumbnailPath?.let { File(it) }?.takeIf { it.isFile }
                            thumbFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(it.absolutePath) }
                            restoredScreenshots.add(
                                PreparedScreenshot(
                                    uploadId = dAtt.uploadId,
                                    file = file,
                                    imageHash = dAtt.imageHash,
                                    sizeBytes = dAtt.sizeBytes,
                                    contentType = dAtt.contentType,
                                    thumbnailFile = thumbFile,
                                    thumbnailSizeBytes = thumbFile?.length(),
                                )
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        campaign = camp,
                        mission = targetMission,
                        isJoined = isJoined,
                        todayReport = myTodayMissionRep,
                        rating = restoredRating,
                        comment = restoredComment,
                        preparedScreenshots = if (restoredScreenshots.isNotEmpty()) restoredScreenshots else it.preparedScreenshots,
                        testStartedAtMs = durableDraft?.testStartedAtMs ?: it.testStartedAtMs,
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, errorMessage = e.message) }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeSubmitState() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            reportSubmitManager.stateForMission(campaignId, missionId).collect { state ->
                _uiState.update { it.copy(submitState = state) }
                if (state?.stage == ReportSubmitManager.Stage.DONE) {
                    // Refresh data to show submitted / approved state
                    loadData()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateRating(newRating: Int) {
        val clamped = newRating.coerceIn(1, 5)
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("rating")] = clamped
        _uiState.update { it.copy(rating = clamped) }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun updateComment(newComment: String) {
        savedStateHandle[draftKey("comment")] = newComment
        _uiState.update { it.copy(comment = newComment) }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun joinMission() {
        if (_uiState.value.isJoining) return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = true, errorMessage = null) }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val res = repository.joinMission(missionId)
                if (res.success) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, isJoined = true, infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_join_success)) }
                } else {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, errorMessage = "Không thể nhận nhiệm vụ") }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isJoining = false, errorMessage = e.message) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun recordTestStart() {
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        _uiState.update { it.copy(testStartedAtMs = now, minTestDurationRemainingSeconds = 10) }
        persistDurableDraft()
        timerJob?.cancel()
        timerJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            for (sec in 10 downTo 0) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(minTestDurationRemainingSeconds = sec) }
                if (sec > 0) delay(1000L)
            }
        }
    }

    fun addScreenshots(uris: List<Uri>) {
        if (uris.isEmpty()) return
        val current = _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots
        val available = 3 - current.size
        if (available <= 0) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_max_photos_reached)) }
            return
        }

        val toProcess = uris.take(available)
        if (uris.size > available) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_photos_truncated, available)) }
        }

        compressionJob?.cancel()
        compressionJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isCompressing = true, compressionError = null) }
            val newPrepared = mutableListOf<PreparedScreenshot>()
            try {
                // Compress sequentially to avoid keeping multiple large bitmaps in memory
                for (uri in toProcess) {
                    val uploadId = PreparedScreenshotCache.newUploadId()
                    val prepared = FirebaseStorageHelper.prepareScreenshot(appContext, uri, uploadId)
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(prepared.file.absolutePath)
                    prepared.thumbnailFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.acquireLease(it.absolutePath) }
                    newPrepared.add(prepared)
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCompressing = false,
                        preparedScreenshots = it.preparedScreenshots + newPrepared,
                    )
                }
                persistDurableDraft()
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                newPrepared.forEach {
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
                    it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
                }
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                newPrepared.forEach {
                    PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
                    it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
                }
                _uiState.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isCompressing = false,
                        compressionError = e.message ?: appContext.getString(R.string.error_image_read_failed),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun removeScreenshot(index: Int) {
        val current = _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots
        if (index !in current.indices) return
        val removed = current[index]
        PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(removed.file.absolutePath)
        removed.thumbnailFile?.let { PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.absolutePath) }

        _uiState.update {
            it.copy(preparedScreenshots = current.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
        }
        persistDurableDraft()
    }

    fun setPreviewScreenshot(screenshot: PreparedScreenshot?) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(previewScreenshot = screenshot, previewUrl = null, previewAttachmentId = null) }
    }

    fun setPreviewUrl(url: String?, attachmentId: String? = null) {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(previewUrl = url, previewScreenshot = null, previewAttachmentId = attachmentId) }
    }

    fun clearMessages() {
        _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = null, infoMessage = null) }
    }

    fun submitReport() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val camp = state.campaign ?: return
        val mission = state.mission ?: return

        if (!state.isJoined) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_not_joined_error)) }
            return
        }

        if (state.isCompressing) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_compressing_wait)) }
            return
        }

        val isApproved = state.todayReport?.isApproved == true

        // 10-second actual app open validation (approved comment update is exempt)
        if (!isApproved) {
            if (state.testStartedAtMs == null) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = "Vui lòng bấm 'Mở app' để kiểm thử ứng dụng trước khi nộp báo cáo") }
                return
            }
            val elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - state.testStartedAtMs
            if (elapsed < 10_000L) {
                val remainingSec = ((10_000L - elapsed + 999) / 1000).toInt()
                _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = "Vui lòng trải nghiệm app thêm ${remainingSec}s trước khi gửi") }
                return
            }
        }

        if (!isApproved && state.preparedScreenshots.isEmpty() && state.todayReport?.screenshotUrl == null) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.mission_report_photo_required)) }
            return
        }

        val uid = repository.currentUserId() ?: return
        val clientSubmitId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

        val request = ReportSubmitManager.SubmitRequest(
            campaignId = campaignId,
            appName = camp.appName,
            userId = uid,
            rating = state.rating,
            comment = state.comment,
            preparedScreenshots = state.preparedScreenshots,
            fallbackScreenshotUrl = state.todayReport?.screenshotUrl,
            fallbackImageHash = state.todayReport?.imageHash,
            needsJoin = false,
            clientSubmitId = clientSubmitId,
            missionId = missionId,
            missionTitle = mission.title,
            submissionContext = "mission",
            expectedDate = VnTime.todayString(),
        )

        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = reportSubmitManager.submit(request)
            when (result) {
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Accepted -> {
                    // Clear local draft upon successful submission admission
                    savedStateHandle.remove<String>(draftKey("comment"))
                    savedStateHandle.remove<Int>(draftKey("rating"))
                    MissionReportDraftStore.clearDraft(appContext, uid, campaignId, missionId, VnTime.todayString())
                }
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.AlreadyInFlight -> {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(infoMessage = appContext.getString(R.string.campaign_report_already_in_flight)) }
                }
                is ReportSubmitManager.SubmitAdmissionResult.Blocked -> {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(errorMessage = result.message ?: result.code) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun retrySubmit() {
        reportSubmitManager.retry(campaignId, missionId)
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        super.onCleared()
        compressionJob?.cancel()
        timerJob?.cancel()
        _uiState.value.preparedScreenshots.forEach {
            PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(it.file.absolutePath)
            it.thumbnailFile?.let { t -> PreparedScreenshotCache.releaseLease(t.absolutePath) }
        }
    }
}

    fun createRequest(
        context: Context,
        model: Any?,
        report: TesterReport? = null,
        descriptor: ScreenshotDescriptor? = null,
        variant: ScreenshotVariant = ScreenshotVariant.FULL,
        crossfade: Boolean = true,
    ): Any? {
        if (model == null) return null
        if (model is ImageRequest) return model
        if (model !is String) return model

        val targetUrl = if (variant == ScreenshotVariant.THUMBNAIL && report != null && !report.thumbnailUrl.isNullOrBlank()) {
            report.thumbnailUrl
        } else {
            model
        }

        val desc = createDescriptor(targetUrl, report, descriptor, variant)
        val builder = ImageRequest.Builder(context)
            .data(targetUrl)

        if (desc != null) {
            builder.tag(ScreenshotDescriptor::class.java, desc)
        }

        if (crossfade) {
            builder.crossfade(true)
        }

        return builder.build()
    }

Analyzing the test cases in `MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest.kt`, the initial focus is on `uploadedCheckpointRestoresOnlyTheMatchingAttachment`. The code snippet reveals a check related to attachments and a boolean `isFirst` which might indicate how the attachment is handled during restoration. Investigating the test logic to understand the expected behavior and its relation to checkpoint restoration.


The `isFirst` flag's behavior is crucial: it determines whether a new URL is assigned or the existing `uploadedUrl` is retained during attachment processing. The legacy single-image request where `attachments` is empty sets `isFirst` to true, contradicting the test's intent to handle the `uploadedUrl` correctly. The issue likely lies in how `isFirst` is evaluated in the logic for `markAttachmentUploaded`. There is a lease check in the cache cleanup method.


The `PendingReportStore.cleanup` method deletes pending reports even if associated `WorkManager` tasks are unresolved, leading to the assertion failure.  The cleanup logic should conditionally skip deletion if a corresponding `WorkManager` task exists and is not finished. Additionally, the `cleanup` method incorrectly double-counts the file size of screenshots by including both the primary report's path and attachment paths, leading to premature eviction of work due to an inflated budget calculation.

import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import com.ntt.crosstest.util.PreparedScreenshot
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest {
    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
    private lateinit var request: PendingReport
    @Before fun before() {
        PendingReportStore.clear(context)
        val requestId=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val images=(0..2).map { position ->
            val imageId=UUID.randomUUID().toString()
            val file=PendingReportStore.newAttachmentScreenshotFile(context,requestId,imageId).apply { writeText("bytes-$position") }
            PendingAttachment(id=imageId,position=position,screenshotPath=file.absolutePath,
                imageHash="0123456789abcdef",sha256=PendingReportStore.screenshotSha256(file))
        }
        request=PendingReport(id=requestId,campaignId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),appName="Mission",
            userId="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",rating=5,comment="Frozen three-image evidence",
            missionId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),submissionContext="mission",attachments=images,
            expectedDate=java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")).toString())
        PendingReportStore.write(context,request)
    }
    @After fun after() { PendingReportStore.clear(context) }
    private inner class Operations : ReportUploadOperations {
        override var isReady=true
        override var currentUserId: String?=request.userId
        val uploads=mutableListOf<String>()
        val submissions=mutableListOf<List<ReportAttachmentInput>>()
        var failThirdOnce=false
        var loseFirstRpcResponse=false
        var committedReceipt: SubmitTesterReportResult?=null
        override suspend fun upload(prepared: PreparedScreenshot,campaignId:String,userId:String):String {
            uploads+=prepared.uploadId
            if(failThirdOnce&&prepared.uploadId==request.attachments[2].id){failThirdOnce=false;throw IOException("third image interrupted")}
            return "https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/cross-testers.firebasestorage.app/o/reports%2F$campaignId%2F$userId%2F${prepared.uploadId}.jpg?alt=media&token=fixture"
        }
        override suspend fun submit(request:PendingReport,url:String?,hash:String?):SubmitTesterReportResult =
            throw AssertionError("multi-image work must submit the complete v3 payload")
        override suspend fun submitV3(request:PendingReport,attachments:List<ReportAttachmentInput>,missionId:String?):SubmitTesterReportResult {
            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.id,request.id)
            assertEquals("mission",request.submissionContext)
            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.expectedDate,request.expectedDate)
            assertEquals(this@MissionWindowWorkerIndependentTest.request.comment,request.comment)
            submissions+=attachments.toList()
            if(committedReceipt==null)committedReceipt=SubmitTesterReportResult(success=true,reportId=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                submissionContext="mission",missionId=missionId,reportDate=request.expectedDate,
                screenshotUrl=attachments.first().screenshotUrl,imageHash=attachments.first().imageHash,
                attachments=attachments.map { ReportAttachment(id=it.id,position=it.position,screenshotUrl=it.screenshotUrl,
                    thumbnailUrl=it.thumbnailUrl,imageHash=it.imageHash,sha256=it.sha256) })
            if(loseFirstRpcResponse){loseFirstRpcResponse=false;throw IOException("response lost after commit")}
            return committedReceipt!!
        }
    }
    private fun worker(operations:Operations,attempt:Int=0):ReportUploadWorker =
        TestListenableWorkerBuilder<ReportUploadWorker>(context)
            .setInputData(workDataOf(ReportUploadWorker.EXTRA_REQUEST_ID to request.id))
            .setRunAttemptCount(attempt)
            .setWorkerFactory(object:WorkerFactory(){
                override fun createWorker(appContext:Context,workerClassName:String,workerParameters:WorkerParameters):ListenableWorker =
                    ReportUploadWorker(appContext,workerParameters,operations)
            }).build()
    @Test fun thirdImageRetryKeepsFirstTwoCheckpointsAndStableOrder()=runBlocking {
        val operations=Operations().apply { failThirdOnce=true }
        assertTrue(worker(operations).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Retry)
        val partial=PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!
        assertNotNull(partial.attachments[0].uploadedUrl)
        assertNotNull(partial.attachments[1].uploadedUrl)
        assertNull(partial.attachments[2].uploadedUrl)
        assertTrue(operations.submissions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(worker(operations,1).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
        assertEquals(listOf(request.attachments[0].id,request.attachments[1].id,request.attachments[2].id,request.attachments[2].id),operations.uploads)
        assertEquals(1,operations.submissions.size)
        assertEquals(request.attachments.map { it.id },operations.submissions.single().map { it.id })
        assertEquals(listOf(0,1,2),operations.submissions.single().map { it.position })
        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
    }
    @Test fun lostRpcResponseAndUnconfirmedWorkSuccessReplayTheFullReceipt()=runBlocking {
        val operations=Operations().apply { loseFirstRpcResponse=true }
        assertTrue(worker(operations).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Retry)
        assertEquals(3,operations.uploads.size)
        assertNull(PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult)
        assertTrue(worker(operations,1).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
        assertEquals(3,operations.uploads.size)
        assertEquals(2,operations.submissions.size)
        assertEquals(operations.submissions[0],operations.submissions[1])
        assertEquals(operations.committedReceipt,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult)
        operations.isReady=false
        assertTrue(worker(operations,2).doWork() is ListenableWorker.Result.Success)
        assertEquals(2,operations.submissions.size)
        assertEquals(3,PendingReportStore.read(context,request.id)!!.completedResult!!.attachments.size)
    }
}

parts.text:
Analyzing the test files, the first assertion in `MissionWindowPersistenceIndependentTest` verifies that the correct URL is restored for a specific attachment after upload. The null check suggests verifying that other attachments remain unaffected, though the specifics of that assertion are unclear without further context.


The assertion failure stems from `restored.uploadedUrl` being populated when it should be null. The test initializes `current.uploadedUrl` to null. The `isFirst` condition determines if `uploadedUrl` is updated. Reviewing the code, `isFirst` evaluates whether the attachment being marked as uploaded is the first in the list, and in this case, it's not. Therefore, the `uploadedUrl` should not be updated. The key issue lies in why the condition did not preserve the initial null value.


The assertion failure results from `current.uploadedUrl` incorrectly getting a non-null value, despite `isFirst` being false. Initially, suspected that an unintentional assignment occurred that bypassed the null check. After re-review, the core logic in the test relies on `isFirst` to properly maintain the initial null state and the assertion failure arises because `uploadedUrl` is changed when it shouldn't be. This suggests that the conditional logic is not working as expected.

Five distinct failures were noted in the feedback. These included issues with queued work being prematurely deleted due to age cleanup, leaked draft files being prematurely deleted without verifying their status, a double-counting issue impacting budget calculations that resulted in queued work eviction, and a failure to clear scoped states during logout, along with dropped attachments/date from a durable receipt at completion.

private fun handleSuccess(report: PendingReport, data: Data, attempt: Int) {
        if (isCancelling) return
        // This callback is reached only after WorkManager has committed SUCCEEDED.
        scope.launch {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { PendingReportStore.delete(appContext, report.id) }
        }

        val isMission = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_IS_MISSION_REPORT, report.missionId != null)
        val missionId = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_ID) ?: report.missionId
        val missionTitle = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_TITLE) ?: report.missionTitle
        val missionRewardCredits = if (data.keyValueMap.containsKey(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_REWARD_CREDITS)) {
            data.getInt(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_REWARD_CREDITS, 0)
        } else null
        val missionEndsAt = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_ENDS_AT)

        val result = SubmitTesterReportResult(
            success = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_SUCCESS, true),
            reportId = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_REPORT_ID).orEmpty(),
            status = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_STATUS) ?: "pending",
            provisionalGranted = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_PROVISIONAL_GRANTED, false),
            provisionalAmount = data.getInt(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_PROVISIONAL_AMOUNT, 0),
            screenshotUrl = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_SCREENSHOT_URL),
            imageHash = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_IMAGE_HASH),
            thumbnailUrl = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_THUMBNAIL_URL),
            submissionContext = if (isMission) "mission" else "app_test",
            missionId = missionId,
            missionTitle = missionTitle,
            missionRewardCredits = missionRewardCredits,
            missionEndsAt = missionEndsAt,
        )
        // Deliver completion for every campaign, including earlier background submissions.
        if (deliveredRequests.add(report.id)) _events.tryEmit(
            SubmitEvent.Success(
                campaignId = report.campaignId,
                appName = report.appName,
                provisionalAmount = if (result.provisionalGranted) result.provisionalAmount else 0,
                isMissionReport = isMission,
                missionTitle = missionTitle,
            )
        )
        if (isCurrentRequest(report.id)) lastFailedRequestId = null
        val sContext = if (isMission) "mission" else "app_test"
        publishState(SubmitState(
            campaignId = report.campaignId,
            stage = Stage.DONE,
            attempt = attempt,
            result = result,
            requestId = report.id,
            isMissionReport = isMission,

private fun handleSuccess(report: PendingReport, data: Data, attempt: Int) {
        if (isCancelling) return

        val durableCompleted = PendingReportStore.read(appContext, report.id)?.completedResult
            ?: report.completedResult

        val isMission = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_IS_MISSION_REPORT, report.missionId != null)
        val missionId = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_ID) ?: report.missionId
        val missionTitle = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_TITLE) ?: report.missionTitle
        val missionRewardCredits = if (data.keyValueMap.containsKey(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_REWARD_CREDITS)) {
            data.getInt(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_REWARD_CREDITS, 0)
        } else null
        val missionEndsAt = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_MISSION_ENDS_AT)

        val result = durableCompleted ?: SubmitTesterReportResult(
            success = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_SUCCESS, true),
            reportId = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_REPORT_ID).orEmpty(),
            status = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_STATUS) ?: "pending",
            provisionalGranted = data.getBoolean(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_PROVISIONAL_GRANTED, false),
            provisionalAmount = data.getInt(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_PROVISIONAL_AMOUNT, 0),
            screenshotUrl = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_SCREENSHOT_URL),
            imageHash = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_IMAGE_HASH),
            thumbnailUrl = data.getString(ReportUploadWorker.KEY_THUMBNAIL_URL),
            submissionContext = if (isMission) "mission" else "app_test",
            missionId = missionId,
            missionTitle = missionTitle,
            missionRewardCredits = missionRewardCredits,
            missionEndsAt = missionEndsAt,
        )

        val sContext = if (isMission) "mission" else "app_test"
        val stateKey = submitStateKey(report.userId, report.campaignId, sContext, missionId, report.expectedDate)

        // Deliver completion for every campaign, including earlier background submissions.
        if (deliveredRequests.add(report.id)) _events.tryEmit(
            SubmitEvent.Success(
                campaignId = report.campaignId,
                appName = report.appName,
                provisionalAmount = if (result.provisionalGranted) result.provisionalAmount else 0,
                isMissionReport = isMission,
                missionTitle = missionTitle,
            )
        )
        if (isCurrentRequest(report.id)) lastFailedRequestId = null
        publishState(SubmitState(
            campaignId = report.campaignId,
            stage = Stage.DONE,
            attempt = attempt,
            result = result,
            requestId = report.id,
            isMissionReport = isMission,
            missionTitle = missionTitle,
            submissionContext = sContext,
            missionId = missionId,
            scopedKey = stateKey,
        ))

        // This callback is reached only after WorkManager has committed SUCCEEDED.
        scope.launch {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { PendingReportStore.delete(appContext, report.id) }
        }
    }
